description: Defines singleton pattern classes and related utilities within the Thunder::Core namespace, including Singleton base class, SingletonType template, SingletonProxyType, and UniqueType for managing singleton instances.

classes.name: Singleton
classes.description: Base class for singleton pattern, manages registration and disposal of singleton instances.

classes.name: SingletonType
classes.description: Template class deriving from Singleton, implements singleton instance management with thread safety and lifecycle control.

classes.name: SingletonProxyType
classes.description: Template class providing proxy-based singleton management.

classes.name: UniqueType
classes.description: Template class for unique singleton instances with reference counting.

methods.name: ImplementationName
methods.description: Pure virtual method to return the implementation name of the singleton.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance, with overloads for default construction and parameterized creation.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates the singleton instance with optional parameters.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a singleton in the singleton list.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a singleton from the singleton list.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance managed by SingletonType.

methods.name: Drop
methods.description: Decrements reference count and deletes singleton if count reaches zero.
